component.name: Cascade
component.summary: Edit video with an AI copilot

description.p: Cascade is a video editor built on the web platform. Titles, lower thirds and effects are live HTML and CSS, so anything a browser can draw can go on your timeline.
An agent panel runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenCode with full access to the editor. It can read transcripts, cut on words and build titles while you stay in charge.

ul.li: Multitrack timeline with keyframes, custom easing and speed ramps
Local transcription with whisper, on the GPU when available
Export to MP4, WebM, ProRes, GIF, WAV and more
Plugins written in TypeScript, reloaded as you save
